title: Welcome to Connections Lab
instruction: Review the graph and note that Genie remains locked until T3. This case is solved with Zingg, GraphFrames and direct relationships.
hint_text: Direct-source, Zingg and GraphFrames connections have different meanings.

title: Read connection provenance
instruction: Open the provenance legend and compare direct-source relationships with engine-generated candidates.
hint_text: A discovered relationship is not automatically a fraud verdict.

title: Quote Zingg
instruction: Request the Zingg quote before running identity matching.
hint_text: The quote is free; the run costs 3 credits.

title: Run Zingg
instruction: Confirm the run to reveal fuzzy identity candidates.
hint_text: Zingg proposes candidates; it does not merge records automatically.

title: Review the strong candidate
instruction: Inspect the agreements and disagreements between Cipher Corgi and C. Corgi.
hint_text: Verified email and phone agree; the given name is only abbreviated.

title: Accept the correct merge
instruction: Merge Cipher Corgi and C. Corgi into one canonical identity.
hint_text: The two source records remain traceable after consolidation.

title: Review the similar name
instruction: Inspect the candidate linking Cipher Corgi and Cypher Corgi.
hint_text: Name similarity is weak when verified identifiers disagree.

title: Reject the false merge
instruction: Keep Cypher Corgi as a separate protected identity.
hint_text: Rejecting a false candidate is as important as accepting a correct one.

title: Trace the directed cycle
instruction: Expand the merged identity component and follow Alpha → Beta → Gamma → Alpha without reversing the arrows.
hint_text: A connected triangle is not enough; the payment directions form the cycle.

title: Quote GraphFrames
instruction: Request the GraphFrames quote before searching for exact structural relationships.

title: Run GraphFrames
instruction: Confirm the run to reveal exact device, IP and address relationships.
hint_text: Exact equality can be relevant or benign depending on context.

title: Classify exact matches
instruction: Mark the administrative device links as relevant and the address and public-kiosk links as shared infrastructure.
hint_text: An exact match can be true without being incriminating.

title: Compare provenance
instruction: Filter the board by provenance and compare direct payment arrows with GraphFrames-derived undirected matches.
hint_text: The bank ledger establishes who paid whom; GraphFrames supplies structural support.

title: Protect the false candidate and tenant
instruction: Protect Cypher Corgi and Blue Bowl Bakery from unsupported attribution.
hint_text: Similar names and shared infrastructure are not culpability.

title: Pin the connection evidence
instruction: Add the identity, cycle, administrative-cluster and shared-infrastructure evidence to the case file.
hint_text: The conclusion must explain both relevant and benign connections.

title: Submit the controller
instruction: Submit the merged Cipher identity as the primary controller.
hint_text: The attempt becomes immutable after submission.

title: Review the connection score
instruction: Review how merge discipline, direction, provenance and protected actors affected the result.
hint_text: Both connection engines add evidence; the investigator determines meaning.
